name: My Cute Mio-Chan
source: It's a short visual novel about us as a main character and Mio Akiyama which is actually a character of manga serie "K-ON!".  The story which has started by accidental meeting in the train. How will two shy and introverted persons communicate with each other and will we get something more?
translation: 这是一部关于我们作为主角和秋山澪的短篇视觉小说，秋山澪实际上是漫画系列“轻音！”的角色。故事因火车上的一次偶然相遇而开始。两个害羞内向的人如何沟通，我们会得到更多的东西吗？
